characters.name: Jahn
characters.voice_notes: Researcher at the Freetown Economics Institute and Seila's friend; articulate, wry, likes explaining history and economics at length; calls the taxi driver 'Chief'.

characters.name: taxi driver
characters.voice_notes: Chatty, pragmatic Freetown taxi driver with a working-class, easygoing manner; calls Jahn 'boss'. Gender not stated in the text.

characters.name: Utaku
characters.voice_notes: Doctoral student at the Freetown Economics Institute; thoughtful, inquisitive, earnest, slightly worried.

characters.name: Zei
characters.voice_notes: Protagonist of the Dzego thread; national Minpentai champion and gifted cryptographer. Curious, quick, precise; explains technical things fluently and matter-of-factly; friendly host to Gladias. Occasionally speaks Dzegoban.

notes: No exceptions. D is the unnamed Freetown taxi driver (gender not given). From 22:73 on, Jahn and Zei talk over a call (Zei is the remote party). 22:126-22:128 are Zei giving voice orders to his drone AI while Jahn listens; 22:129 and 22:130 are cut-off words. All attributions confident.
